The nearer demand driver is a dry cold snap: highs in the low 60s on Nov 23, 2026 fall to the mid-40s, with lows near 19–25°F by Nov 25, 2026. # Punctual Pros: this week's storm exposure

This week's severe alerts sit on the New Jersey coast, not in Punctual Pros' Pennsylvania hubs. The nearer demand driver is a dry cold snap: highs in the low 60s on Nov 23, 2026 fall to the mid-40s, with lows near 19–25°F by Nov 25, 2026. That points to heating calls more than storm repairs (est.).

## Where the alerts are

- All 5 active alerts are in NJ. Pennsylvania has 0 (National Weather Service alerts).
- **High Wind Watches** cover the Delaware Beaches, Cape May, Atlantic, Monmouth and Ocean coasts. Winds run from Nov 26, 2026 to Nov 27, 2026. The watch text cites east winds of 25–35 mph and gusts from 50 mph upward. Certainty is "Possible."
- **Coastal Flood Watches** cover Ocean, Atlantic, Burlington, Middlesex, Monmouth, Cumberland and Cape May counties over the same window.
- Atlantic County is tagged "adjacent" to Punctual Pros territory, not core (Punctual Pros storm events). The context does not give a tier for the other alerted counties.

## Conditions at the PA hubs

| Lancaster | 63.1 | 19.4 | 30.2 |

| Carlisle | 59.6 | 24.4 | 30.4 |
| Reading | 63.5 | 24.1 | 29.8 |
| Lebanon | 61.3 | 21.1 | 30.0 |

- No precipitation or snow is forecast through Nov 25, 2026 (Open-Meteo 7-day forecast).
- Only 6 of 10 hubs, and days through Nov 25, are visible in the snapshot.

## What it means for demand

- **HVAC.** This is likely the first hard freeze after a warm stretch. That tends to trigger no-heat calls (est.).
  - The HVAC baseline is 10 market-wide reactive calls per day per 10k households, with a range of 8–13 (Punctual Pros demand model).
  - Heating multipliers in the model are assumptions, not fitted values.
- **Electrical and plumbing.** The model's electrical scope includes surge damage and generators. Wind-driven outage calls are plausible only where Punctual Pros serves the NJ coast (est.).
- **Call volume.** It cannot be sized. The model needs Punctual Pros' county market share, which is an unknown parameter. Fitted weather elasticities also need 12+ months of booked-call data.

## Next actions

- Pull Punctual Pros booked-call history by trade and county. Use it to set market share and run the model for Nov 24 to Nov 27, 2026. Label the output est.
- Confirm with management which NJ counties Punctual Pros actually dispatches into. Then decide whether the wind and flood watches matter at all.
- Check on-call HVAC technician coverage for the Nov 25 to Nov 27 freeze, including the holiday.
- Re-pull the alert and forecast snapshots daily through Nov 27, 2026. The watches are "Possible" and could change.
